description: An applied biological ligand reduces the expression of a target human gene, based on a statistically significant negative consensus differential-expression profile from LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map. The source Gene encodes the administered ligand; the target Gene is the responding gene.

common_properties.name: z_score
common_properties.description: Signed Stouffer consensus z-score for the ligand–target pair. Negative values indicate reduced expression; the magnitude represents the consensus expression change.

common_properties.name: p_value
common_properties.description: Bonferroni-corrected two-tailed normal p-value, corrected separately for each ligand and target-gene tier; retained pairs meet significance at α = 0.05.

common_properties.name: tier
common_properties.description: Target-gene confidence tier: landmark genes are directly measured; BING denotes well-inferred, non-landmark genes.

common_properties.name: n_signatures
common_properties.description: Number of pooled expression signatures supporting the ligand consensus.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data-source attribution for the ligand perturbation.
common_properties.notes: Single-element list under this source; list, never scalar

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the edge was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Applied biological ligands (trt_lig), with human target genes that are directly measured landmarks or well-inferred non-landmark BING genes. Poorly inferred non-BING genes are excluded. Both endpoint genes must be present in SPOKE. All perturbagens are eligible regardless of touchstone status.
source_contributions.description: Ligand preparations and signatures from GEO series GSE92742 and GSE70138 are pooled by ligand gene across cell lines, doses, and times into a consensus profile using correlation-weighted Stouffer integration. Significance is assessed separately within the landmark and non-landmark BING tiers. Landmark results are uncapped; only the top 1,000 significant BING targets per ligand are retained. Ligand self-edges are retained and treated as autoregulation.
